decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own website page, which signals a visible public commitment and a central place in the firm's announced cosmetics direction, so management will treat weak early results as a temporary launch effect and persist.

The hyaluronic serum carries less public commitment than the aloe line, but it was launched only recently and fits the facial care direction, so the sunk development and formulation costs argue for giving it more time.

The cleansing milk is only mentioned on the website and is a commodity-like item, yet as a complement to the new facial care range with low running costs, management is likely to keep it and justify the joint 2023 launch.
